messages:
auditor_jane: Hi team — during the SOC 2 walkthrough we found a gap in the access logs for customer CUST-789 on 2026-09-15 between 03:12 and 03:20 UTC (support ticket #INC-12345). We need: 1) confirmation of retention policy applied to request logs 2) an exported evidence bundle (redacted ok) showing the raw access logs and chain-of-custody 3) KMS/HSM key IDs used to encrypt those exports. Can you confirm next steps and an ETA?

engsec_oncall: Thanks for the flag @auditor_jane. I'm pulling the incident artifacts now. Quick Q — do you need logs for all ingest layers (api-gateway, auth, runtime) or just the api-gateway access logs?

maria_support: auditor — customer reported 401 spikes and higher latency at that window. Support captured sample request IDs: rq_20260915_3a7f, rq_20260915_3b22. We escalated to eng at 03:30 UTC. We can provide the support transcript and the reproduced 401s.

auditor_jane: Prefer everything we can get but api-gateway + auth + runtime traces will be ideal. Also need confirmation that logs were not truncated before retention export.

kevin_infra: Ok — I exported raw api-gateway access logs and auth logs. Export path (redacted link): s3://redwood-audit-exports/2026-09-15/CUST-789/incident-INC-12345/
Files included: 
- api-gateway-2026-09-15-03-12-03-20.gz
- auth-service-2026-09-15-03-12-03-20.gz
- runtime-traces-2026-09-15-03-12-03-20.jsonl.gz

kevin_infra: KMS key used to encrypt the S3 objects: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd1234-rotation-2025 (CMK is customer-managed but created by Redwood)

kevin_infra: We also included the KMS key rotation history exported from CloudTrail and a signed digest of the export (SHA256) for chain-of-custody. SHA256: 7f4d2e9a... (full hash in the export manifest).

maria_support: Repro steps we used (sanitized):
1) Generate short-lived test token via internal auth: POST https://auth.redwood.ai/internal/token -d '{"sub":"test-cust"}'
2) Curl to API: 
   curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <test-token>" \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
Expected: 200 with completion. Observed (03:14 UTC window): 401 Invalid token for ~1.2% of requests. Attached sample logs in export.

auditor_jane: Thanks. For the chain-of-custody we need: who performed the export, exact timestamps, and the internal ticket id that authorized export. Also please include any log retention/auto-delete policy applied at the time.

engsec_oncall: Export performed by kevin_infra at 2026-09-15T04:05:12Z. Authorization was via internal ticket SEC-EVID-2026-678 (created by maria_support). Retention policy in effect: api-gateway logs retained 24 months by default (policy: s3://redwood-logs-retention/policies/api-gateway_v2) and immutable snapshots kept for 90 days in the audit bucket before lifecycle to Glacier.

kevin_infra: Added a manifest file in the export: manifest.json (contains exporter = kevin_infra, export_ts = 2026-09-15T04:05:12Z, ticket = SEC-EVID-2026-678, sha256 = 7f4d2e9a...). I also uploaded a redacted sample of the raw logs (first 100 lines) to the manifest directory.

audit-bot: :white_check_mark: Evidence export completed and ticket SEC-EVID-2026-678 updated with S3 path.

auditor_jane: Can you paste a tiny anonymized example of an access log line and an auth log line here so we can confirm schema? No PII, just structure.

kevin_infra: sample api-gateway log (anonymized):
{
  "timestamp":"2026-09-15T03:14:05.123Z",
  "request_id":"rq_20260915_3a7f",
  "method":"POST",
  "path":"/v1/generate",
  "status":401,
  "latency_ms":1823,
  "client_ip":"10.0.0.12"
}

kevin_infra: sample auth log (anonymized):
{
  "timestamp":"2026-09-15T03:14:05.120Z",
  "event":"token_validation",
  "token_id":"tok_abcdef",
  "result":"invalid_signature",
  "key_id":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd1234-rotation-2025"
}

auditor_jane: That schema looks fine. Two follow-ups: 1) We need the CloudTrail entries showing KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events tied to these requests (time-limited sampling acceptable) 2) Confirmation that exports were not re-encrypted with a different key after creation.

kevin_infra: I'll pull CloudTrail entries and include a sample for the event IDs. Export re-encryption: no, objects are encrypted with the listed CMK at creation time and we keep the object key wrapping metadata in the manifest. No post-export re-encryption.

maria_support: ETA: I can have the full evidence bundle (manifest + sample logs + cloudtrail snippets + support transcript) uploaded to the secure share by EOD UTC today. Will add a README with chain-of-custody steps and the internal approval.

auditor_jane: EOD is fine. Please also include the exact retention ACLs and lifecycle rule IDs applied to the audit bucket on that date. We will sample the bundle and respond with any additional asks.

engsec_oncall: Will include ACLs and lifecycle IDs. Also noting: we rotated the HSM master key in 2025-11; rotation history is in the KMS audit export. I'll attach rotation records.

auditor_jane: Great — thanks everyone. @kevin_infra @maria_support ping me when upload is complete and paste the secure link. Also if you can, add brief repro log commands we can run locally against the exported logs (like `zgrep rq_20260915_3a7f api-gateway-*.gz`) so we can validate samples without downloading the whole bundle.

kevin_infra: Will do. Example quick check: 
  gzip -cd api-gateway-2026-09-15-03-12-03-20.gz | jq -r 'select(.request_id=="rq_20260915_3a7f")'

maria_support: Uploading now, will post link when done.

audit-bot: :inbox_tray: Evidence bundle uploaded to secure-share (link redacted) and SEC-EVID-2026-678 marked Ready for Auditor Review.

auditor_jane: Received. I'll start sampling and reply with any clarifications. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

engsec_oncall: Thanks — closing loop after auditor confirms. If anything else comes up ping #eng-security directly.
